title: The Practice of Generosity
speaker: Heigaku Talus Latona
summary: The talk explores the concept of "not killing" as one of the five hindrances in Buddhism, highlighting how our actions and thoughts can be forms of harm, even if they seem minor or unintentional. It emphasizes the importance of acknowledging and addressing harmful tendencies through mindfulness and compassion, rather than just avoiding overt violence. By cultivating a deeper understanding of interconnectedness and acting with kindness and wisdom, we can transform our daily choices into expressions of compassion and non-harm, ultimately leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
